n-k-k3-01.title: Usbuuc-dhammaad guriga?
n-k-k3-01.topic: Erayada tirada marka: sheegasho iyo caddayn
n-k-k3-01.goal: Barbardhig sheegasho xooggan oo fasal-wadaag ah iyo buug-xusuus gaaban, dooro erayga tirada marka ee caddaynta taageerto, oo sharax sababta 'had iyo jeer' u badan yahay.
n-k-k3-01.material:
Fasal-wadaag ayaa leh: "세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요." Waxaad akhrisay buug-xusuuska usbuuc-dhammaadka ee 세진 afar usbuuc:

1주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
1주 일요일: 집에서 책을 읽었어요.
2주 토요일: 친구랑 극장에서 영화를 봤어요.
2주 일요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
3주 토요일: 집에서 게임을 했어요.
3주 일요일: 집에서 청소를 했어요.
4주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
4주 일요일: 공원에서 자전거를 탔어요.
n-k-k3-01.thinking.2: Hal tusaale lid ku ah ayaa jebiya 'had iyo jeer'
n-k-k3-01.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan 항상 (had iyo jeer) iyo 아니에요 (maaha); erayada kale ee tirada marka (보통, 가끔, 거의) waxaa lagu macneeyay tilmaamaha iyo sharaxaadda
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.prompt: Weedhda ku saabsan 세진 kee ayaa ugu wanaagsan ee buug-xusuuska oo dhan taageerayo?
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tiri intee ka mid ah 8-da maalmood ee usbuuc-dhammaadka guriga laga joogay iyo intee ma ahayn.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Labadaada tiro la mid ka dhig erayada: 항상 = mar kasta, 보통 = inta badan, 가끔 = mararka qaarkood, 거의 없어요 = marar yar oo aad u yar.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.a: Laba ka mid ah siddeedda maalmood waxaa laga joogay dibadda (shineemo iyo beer), sidaa darteed 'had iyo jeer' wuxuu ka sii fogaanayaa buug-xusuuska.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.b: Lix ka mid ah siddeedda maalmood guriga ayaa laga joogay, sidaa darteed 'marna guriga' waa ka soo horjeedka waxa buug-xusuuska muujiyo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.d: '가끔' macnaheedu waa mararka qaarkood oo keliya. Buug-xusuuska wuxuu muujinayaa guriga maalmaha badankood, taas oo ka badan 'mararka qaarkood'.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.e: '거의 없어요' macnaheedu waa ku dhawaad marna guriga, taas oo ka soo horjeedda lix maalmood siddeed guriga.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.explain: Tiri maalmaha: 6 ka mid ah 8 maalmood usbuuc-dhammaadka guriga ayaa laga joogay, 2 ma ahayn. Eray u taagan 'inta badan' (보통) ayaa ku habboon; eray u taagan 'mar kasta' (항상) aad buu u xoog badan yahay, 'mararka qaarkood' ama 'marar yar' aad bay u daciif yihiin.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.prompt: Fasal-wadaagaagu wuxuu leeyahay '세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요.' Qoraalada buug-xusuuska kuwee ayaa muujinaya in sheegashadan aanay run ahayn? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sheegashadu waxay ku saabsan tahay MAALIN KASTA ee usbuuc-dhammaadka. Maalin noocee ayaa jebin lahayd: mid ku habboon sheegashada mise mid aan ku habboonayn?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qoraal kasta, go'aami: ma ku habboon yahay sheegashada mise wuu jebiyaa?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.a: Maalintan waxaa guriga laga joogay, sidaa darteed way ku heshiin tahay sheegashada. Ma muujin karto in sheegashadu khaldan tahay.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.c: Maalintan sidoo kale waxaa guriga laga joogay, sidaa darteed way ku heshiin tahay sheegashada.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.explain: Sheegasho leh 'had iyo jeer' waxaa jebiya hal maalin oo aan ku habboonayn. Maalmaha guriga laga joogay sheegashada kaliya ayay ku heshiin, marna ma caddayn karaan, sababtoo ah sheegashadu waxay ku saabsan tahay maalin kasta.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.acc.0: Hal tusaale lid ku ah ayaa mar horeba ku filan inuu jebiyo '항상'; kan labaad, 4주 일요일, wuxuu muujinayaa inaanay ahayn mid keliya.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.prompt: U jawaab fasal-wadaagaaga af Kuuriyaan (hadal edeb leh -요). Dheh '항상' ma saxna, oo sii hal maalin buug-xusuuska ah sida caddayn.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ku bilow qaybta leh 'maaha had iyo jeer', kadibna ku dar hal qoraal buug-xusuuska ah.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sheeg meesha 세진 ku jiray maalintaas, adigoo isticmaalaya -에서.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma magacaabay hal maalin ama meel gaar ah oo buug-xusuuska ka timid?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma idhi 'maaha had iyo jeer' halkii 'marna'?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma jawaabtaydu waa saaxiibtinimo oo ma aha mid qallafsan?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Waxay magacaabaysaa erayga ka wanaagsan oo bixisaa caddayn.

n-k-k3-02.title: Qorshaha 하나 iyo ogeysiiska maktabadda
n-k-k3-02.topic: Is-dhacyada waqtiga iyo meesha ee u dhexeeya qorshe iyo ogeysiis
n-k-k3-02.goal: Hubi qorshaha usbuuca ee saaxiib iyadoo la barbardhigayo ogeysiis, ka hel hal khad oo is dhaca, sheeg nooca is-dhaca, oo hagaaji qorshaha.
n-k-k3-02.material:
하나 wuxuu kuu soo diraa qorshaheeda usbuucan. Maktabadda dugsigu waxay dhejisay ogeysiiskan:

[학교 도서관 안내]
- 문을 열어요: 화요일~일요일, 오전 9시~오후 6시
- 월요일은 쉬어요.
- 책은 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
n-k-k3-02.thinking.0: Hubinta qorshe iyadoo la barbardhigayo il
n-k-k3-02.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan maalmaha usbuuca iyo 오전/오후 + tiro + 시
n-k-k3-02.prereq.2: Wuu yaqaan 쉬어요 (waa xiran yahay / nasanaysa)
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.prompt: Qorshaha 하나 ee usbuucan ma ku habboona ogeysiiska maktabadda hal khad. Dooro khadkaas.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore liis garee maalmaha iyo saacadaha maktabaddu furan tahay, adigoo isticmaalaya ogeysiiska oo keliya.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi khad kasta oo sheegaya maktabadda: ma maalinta IYO saacaddu waxay ku habboon yihiin liiskaaga?
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.explain: Khadka 2 wuxuu leeyahay maktabadda Isniinta, laakiin ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay maktabaddu waa xiran tahay Isniinta. Khadka 5 (Axadda, 5 p.m.) waa fiican yahay sababtoo ah maktabaddu waa furan tahay Axadaha ilaa 6 p.m.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Barbardhig maalinta khadka ogeysiiska, kadibna barbardhig saacadda.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sheeg midka labadaas (maalin, saacad), haddii mid ka mid ah, aan ku habboonayn ogeysiiska.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.a: 하나 waxay qorsheysaa inay tagto ka hor intaanay maktabaddu furmin.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.a: Saacadda furitaanku waa 9 a.m., sidaa darteed 10 a.m. waxay ku jirtaa saacadaha furitaanka; dhibaatadu waa faahfaahin kale.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.b: 하나 waxay qorsheysaa inay tagto maalin qorshaheedu la dhaco khad kale.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.b: Ma jiro khad kale oo qorshaheeda ka mid ah oo maalintaas ku dhacaya, sidaa darteed tani ma aha dhibaatada.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.c: 하나 waxay qorsheysaa inay tagto waqti ka dib markii maktabaddu xirantay.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.c: Saacadda (10 a.m.) waxay ku jirtaa saacadaha furitaanka; dhibaatadu waa faahfaahin kale.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.d: 하나 waxay qorsheysaa inay tagto maalin maktabaddu xiran tahay.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.explain: Saacaddu waa fiican tahay, laakiin maalin xiran ayaa ka dhigaysa booqashada oo dhan mid aan suurtagal ahayn. Hubinta qorshe iyadoo la barbardhigayo ogeysiis macnaheedu waa hubinta faahfaahin kasta (maalin, saacad, meel), oo hal faahfaahin ayaa ku filan inay jebiso.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor khadka khaldan af Kuuriyaan (hadal edeb leh) si qorshuhu u shaqeeyo. Ilaali ujeeddada (amaahda buugaagta), laakiin beddel maalinta ama waqtiga.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dooro maalin ka mid ah maalmaha furan ee ogeysiiska; kadibna dooro saacad u dhexeysa furitaanka iyo xiridda.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ilaali qaabka maalin + waqti: meel + shay + fal, sida khadadka kale.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma maalinta cusubi waa mid maktabaddu furan tahay?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma waqtigayga cusub wuxuu ku habboon yahay saacadaha furitaanka (9 a.m. ilaa 6 p.m.)?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma maalinta cusubi waxay la dhacdaa khad kale oo qorshaha 하나?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Waxay sharraxaysaa sababta maalinta loo beddelay.

n-k-k3-03.title: Ballan filim oo xaddidaadyo leh
n-k-k3-03.topic: Dhowr shuruud oo mid qarsoon leh
n-k-k3-03.goal: U beddel qoraalka saaxiib oo leh dhowr xaddidaad (maalmo aan la heli karin, saacadda ugu horreysa, waqti dhammaad go'an) qorshayaal ansax ah, ka hel in ka badan hal, oo hal ku warbixi af Kuuriyaan.
n-k-k3-03.material:
지호 wuxuu kuu qoraa:

"이번 주 평일에 같이 영화를 봐요! 월요일이랑 수요일에는 학원이 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 3시 이후에 시간이 있어요. 영화는 두 시간이에요. 오후 6시까지는 끝나야 해요."
n-k-k3-03.thinking.0: Shuruud qarsoon: dhererka filimku wuxuu beddelaa waqtiga bilowga
n-k-k3-03.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan maalmaha shaqada iyo 오후 + tiro + 시
n-k-k3-03.prereq.2: Wuu la kulmay -까지 (ilaa), 이후 (ka dib) iyo 전에 (ka hor); waxaa lagu sharraxay tilmaamaha
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.prompt: Filimku waa 2 saacadood oo dherer ah oo waa inuu dhammaado 6 p.m. Waa maxay waqtiga bilowga ugu dambeeya ee shaqeeya?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qaado saacadda 6 oo ka jar dhererka filimka.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi jawaabtaada adigoo ku darayo 2 saacadood. Natiijadu ma tahay 6 ama ka hor?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.b: Taasi waa waqtiga filimku waa inuu ku dhammaado, ma aha waqtiga uu bilaaban karo.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.c: Bilaabidda 5 p.m. macnaheedu waa filimku wuxuu dhammaanayaa 7 p.m., taas oo ka dambaysa 6.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 p.m. way shaqaysaa, laakiin waa bilowga ugu horreeya ee saaxiibkaa oggolaaday, ma aha kan ugu dambeeya.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.explain: Bilow + 2 saacadood waa inay noqdaan 6 ama ka hor, sidaa darteed bilowgu waa 4 ugu dambayn. Isla 'ka dib 3 p.m.' kaliya 3 iyo 4 ayaa suurtagal ah.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka hel 3 qorshe oo ku habboon shuruud kasta oo fariinta 지호, mid walba maalin kala duwan ama waqti kala duwan. d = lambarka maalinta (월=1, 화=2, 수=3, 목=4, 금=5); h = saacadda uu filimku bilaabmayo, galabta (3 macnaheedu waa 3 p.m.).
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.0: 이후 = ka dib (laga bilaabo) waqtigaas; -까지 = ilaa / ka hor waqtigaas.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qor fariinta erayadaaga u gaarka ah sida xeerar kala gooni ah: maalmaha lagu yaalo, laga bilaabo saacadda, iyo saacadda filimku dhammaado.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.2: Marka hore sameey maalmaha: ka xariiq 월 iyo 수. Kadibna tijaabi saacad bilow kasta oo ku dar 2.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.3: Haddii mid ka mid ah qorshayaashaada la diido, akhri fariinta miiska hoostiisa: waxay sheegaysaa xeerka fashilmay.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Isticmaal lambarka maalinta oo dhan iyo saacad dhan.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 지호 wuxuu rabaa maalin shaqo, sidaas darteed d waa 1 ilaa 5.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 지호 wuxuu leeyahay 학원 월요일 (1) iyo 수요일 (3).
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c3: 지호 waa bannaan laga bilaabo 3 p.m. oo keliya.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Filimku wuxuu dhammaadaa ugu dambeyn 6 p.m.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Filim 2 saacadood ah oo bilaabma aad u dambeeya wuxuu dhammaadaa ka dib 6 p.m.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.explain: Maalmuhu waxay noqon karaan 화, 목 ama 금, bilowguna wuxuu noqon karaa 3 ama 4 p.m., sidaas darteed waxaa jira 6 qorshe. Fariintu waxay bixisaa xadado, ma aha hal ballan oo sax ah.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro HAL qorshe oo ka mid ah kuwaaga oo u dir 지호 fariin gaaban oo Kuuriyaan ah (edeb -요) leh maalinta, waqtiga bilowga iyo filimka.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isticmaal hal qorshe oo kor ah: maalinteee iyo saacaddee?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Dheh maalinta, kadibna waqtiga, kadibna filimka, oo ku dhammee -요.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma maalintayda iyo saacaddaydu waxay waafaqsan yihiin hal qorshe oo aan dhisay?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma qaanuunnada 지호 la ixtiraami lahaa haddii uu yidhaahdo haa?

n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aami adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad ilaa hadda akhrisay oo keliya.
n-k-k3-04.title: Ma 민수 ayaa imaanaya xafladda?
n-k-k3-04.goal: Cusboonaysii xukunka ku saabsan in saaxiib fasal imaanayo marka fariimo cusub yimaadaan, aqoonso erayada qiyaasta, oo sheeg wararka adigoo isticmaalaya heerka saxda ah ee hubaalka.
n-k-k3-04.material: Waxaad ururinaysaa magacyo xafladda fasalka ee Sabtida oo waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato imisa cunto ayaad iibsanayso. Waxaad la yaabtaa in 민수 imaanayo. Fariimuhu waxay yimaadaan mid mid.
n-k-k3-04.thinking.1: Yaa yidhi (qiyaas saaxiib iyo qofka laftiisa)
n-k-k3-04.thinking.2: Beddelidda gabagabo marka macluumaad cusub yimaado
n-k-k3-04.prereq.1: Wuxuu la kulmay 아마 (laga yaabo) iyo -ㄹ 것 같아요 (waxay u egtahay); waxaa lagu sharaxay tilmaamaha
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.prompt: Akhri fariin kasta nidaamka, dooro akhrinta u muuqata mid ugu badan, kadibna sii wad.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ogow cidda ku hadlaysa fariin kasta, iyo erayada jilciya weedh (아마, -ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Intee hubaal u tahay 지아 in 민수 imaan doono Sabtida?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 아마 wuxuu calaamadeeyaa qiyaas. Wakhtigan, 'laga yaabo inuu imaanayo' waa akhrinta macquulka ah, ma aha 'hubaal inuu imaanayo'.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waxay gabi ahaanba hubtaa inuu imaan doono.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: '아마' macnaheedu waa 'laga yaabo'. Hadle gabi ahaanba hubaa uma baahnayn.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Weedhda waxba kuma jiraan sheegaya inuusan imaan doonin; '올 거예요' wuxuu tilmaamayaa imaatin.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Waxay u malaynaysaa inuu laga yaabo inuu imaan doono, laakiin ma hubto.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Waxay ka hadlaysaa isagoo qof ay taqaanno; weedhdu waxay ku saabsan tahay inuu imaanayo iyo in kale.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda 민수 laftiisa ayaa hadlaya. Sawirku sidee u eg yahay?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.after: -ㄹ 것 같아요 iyo 아직 몰라요 waxay muujiyaan su'aal furan. Waxa qofku laftiisa yidhaahdo ayaa ka muhiimsan qiyaasta saaxiib.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ma go'nayn: laga yaabo inuu leeyahay booqasho cusbitaal, sidaas darteed laga yaabo inuusan imaan karin.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Laga yaabo inuu imaan doono, sababtoo ah 지아 ayaa sidaas yidhi.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hadda qofka laftiisa ayaa leh ma hubo, sidaas darteed qiyaasta 지아 miisaan yar ayay leedahay.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Laga yaabo inuu horey u tegay cusbitaalka.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '갈 것 같아요' wuxuu ku saabsan yahay booqasho mustaqbal oo suurtagal ah, ma aha wax horey u dhacay.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Laga yaabo inuu go'aansaday inuusan imaan doonin.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: '아직 몰라요' macnaheedu waa weli ma go'aansan, sidaas darteed ma odhan kartid inuusan imaan doonin.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Maxaad hadda odhan kartaa marka aad qorsheynayso xafladda?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Fariinta cusub waxay beddeshaa qiyaastii hore: imaatinku hadda waa mid aad u cad, 'wax yar daahitaan' weli waa qiyaas (-ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Laga yaabo inuu 민수 imaan karin cusbitaalka awgiis.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Booqashada cusbitaalka horey ayay u dhammaatay (다녀왔어요), wuxuuna leeyahay wuu imaan karaa.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Laga yaabo inuu 민수 imaan doono waqtigii.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wuxuu leeyahay wax yar ayuu daahi doonaa, sidaas darteed waa inaadan qorsheyn waqtigii.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Weli lama ogaan karo inuu imaanayo iyo in kale.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hadda si cad ayuu leeyahay wuu tegi karaa Sabtida; su'aashii furnayd ee shalay waa la jawaabay.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 민수 wuu imaan karaa Sabtida, laga yaabo wax yar daahitaan.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.reflect: Fikraddaada ku saabsan 민수 waa is beddeshay fariin kasta. Qiyaas saaxiib (아마) waxaa beddelay erayadiisa aan hubin, kadibna erayadiisa ka cad. Erayada sida 아마 iyo -ㄹ 것 같아요 waxay calaamadeeyaan qiyaasyo, fariinta ugu cusub ee qofka laftiisa waa isha ugu fiican.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.prompt: Weedhahee saddexda fariin ka mid ah ayaa muujinaya in hadlaha aanu gabi ahaanba hubin? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Weedh kasta weydii: ma hadlaha wuxuu sheegayaa wax dhacay, mise wuxuu qiyaasayaa wax dhici kara?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Isku day inaad weedhda ku beddesho 'hubaal'. Weedhdu weli ma macno yeelatay?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.r.b: Tani waa hadal fudud oo ku saabsan wax horey u dhacay, sidaas darteed waa xaqiiqo, ma aha qiyaas.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.explain: 아마 macnaheedu waa laga yaabo, -ㄹ 것 같아요 macnaheedu waa 'waxay u egtahay', 아직 몰라요-na macnaheedu waa 'weli ma ogi'. Hadal waqti tegay sida 다녀왔어요 wuxuu soo sheegayaa xaqiiqo.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.prompt: Qor wararka wada hadalka kooxda xafladda Kuuriyaan ahaan (hadal edeb leh): dheh 민수 wuu imaanayaa, oo calaamadee hal shay oo weli qiyaas ah.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qor laba weedhood oo gaaban: mid wuxuu cadyahay, mid waxa aan cadayn.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.1: Qaybta aan cadayn, isticmaal eray ama dhammaad aad ku aragtay fariimaha.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma si cad ayaan u idhi wuu imaanayaa?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma ilaaliyey qaybta 'wax yar daahitaan' sida qiyaas, ma aha sida xaqiiqo?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma kooxdu ogaan lahayd imisa qof ayay tiriyaan?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wuxuu isticmaalaa 아마 iyo 쯤 qiyaasta.

n-k-k3-05.title: Yaa 하준 uga jeeda '저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.topic: Yaa maxay yidhi: jawaab ku xiran sadarka ka horreeya
n-k-k3-05.goal: Xalli yaa iyo maxay tilmaamayaa 'aniguna' gaaban oo ku jira wada hadal kooxeed, go'aami xaqiiqooyinka weli maqan go'aan kooxeed, oo weydii mid ka mid ah.
n-k-k3-05.material:
Saddex saaxiib ayaa doorata qado wada hadal koox ah. 비빔밥 makhaayadda caadi ahaan wuxuu la yimaadaa suugo basbaas cas oo xanuun badan (고추장).

지아: 저는 비빔밥을 먹을래요.
하준: 저도 비빔밥이 좋아요.
서윤: 저는 매운 음식을 못 먹어요.
하준: 저도요.
n-k-k3-05.thinking.0: Yaa maxay yidhi, iyo waxa jawaab tilmaamayo
n-k-k3-05.thinking.1: Go'aaminta macluumaadka weli loo baahan yahay
n-k-k3-05.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan -도 (sidoo kale) iyo 못 + fal (ma awoodo)
n-k-k3-05.prereq.2: Wuxuu yaqaan 맵다 (xanuun badan) qaabka 매운 / 안 매워요
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.prompt: Akhri wada hadalka. Sadarka ugu dambeeya, maxay 하준 uga jeedaa '저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hel sadarka isla markiiba ka sarreeya '저도요'. Taasi waa waxa uu la heshiinayo.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.1: Is weydii: 'sidoo kale' macnaheedu waa isku mid cidda, iyo waxa?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.a: Isna wuxuu rabaa inuu cuno 비빔밥, sida 지아.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.a: '저도요' wuxuu jawaabaa sadarka isla markiiba ka horreeya. Sadarkaas waa 서윤's, ma aha 지아's.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.b: Isna wuxuu rabaa inuu qado la cuno 서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.b: Sadarka ka horreeya wuxuu ku saabsan yahay cunto, ma aha wada cunista.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.c: Isna wuxuu u malaynayaa 비빔밥 inuu aad u xanuun badan yahay.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.c: 서윤 wuxuu leeyahay oo keliya ma cuni karto cunto xanuun badan. 하준 wuxuu ka jawaabayaa sadarkaas oo wax ku saabsan 비빔밥 halkan ma leh.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.d: Isna ma cuni karo cunto xanuun badan, sida 서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.explain: '-도' (sidoo kale) wuxuu isku xiraa waxa hadda la yidhi iyo waxa hadda la yidhi. Sadarka isla markiiba ka horreeya kan 하준 waa 서윤's: ma cuni karto cunto xanuun badan. Sidaas darteed 하준 sidoo kale ma cuni karo. Laba sadar hore wuxuu yidhi wuu jecel yahay 비빔밥, sidaas darteed waa inuu u malaynayaa 비빔밥 inuu noqon karo mid jilicsan.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.prompt: Ma saddexda saaxiib dhammaantood wada cuni karaan 비빔밥? Dooro DHAMMAAN waxyaabaha weli aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato ka hor intaadan jawaabin.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.0: Samee liis waxa qof kasta yidhi, oo calaamadee waxa weli maqan mid kasta.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka tir xaqiiqooyinka aan beddeli lahayn jawaabta, wixii ay noqdaanba.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.a: Ma makhaayaddu sameyn kartaa 비빔밥 aan xanuun badnayn
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.b: Ma 하준 runtii ma cuni karo cunto xanuun badan
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.b: Hadda ayuu sidaas yidhi 저도요, sidaas darteed horey ayaad u ogtahay.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.c: Ma 지아 ayaa cunay 비빔밥 shalay
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.c: Waxa 지아 cunay shalay ma go'aamiyo waxa saddexdu cuni karaan maanta.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.d: Ma 서윤 diyaar u tahay inay cunto 비빔밥 haddii aanu xanuun badnayn
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.e: Ma 지아 jecel yahay cunto xanuun badan
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.e: 지아 wuxuu rabaa 비빔밥 hab kasta; dhadhankeeda xanuunku ma joojiyo kuwa kale inay cunaan.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.explain: Laba shay ayaa furan. Cuntadu waa inay suurtagal noqotaa xanuun la'aan, 서윤-na waxay sheegtay waxa ay cuni karin oo keliya, ma aha waxa ay rabto. Xaqiiqooyinka kale ma beddelaan jawaabta.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.prompt: Qor su'aal wada hadalka kooxda Kuuriyaan ahaan (hadal edeb leh) oo kuu keenaysa mid ka mid ah xaqiiqooyinka maqan. Ha go'aamin keligaa.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dooro mid ka mid ah xaqiiqooyinka maqan ee aad heshay.
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.hint.1: U beddel su'aal adigoo isticmaalaya -요? ama -ㄹ까요?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma jawaabtu ayay i siin laheyd mid ka mid ah labada xaqiiqo ee maqan?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma su'aashaydu waa edeb oo fudud in lagu jawaabo hal weedh oo gaaban?
n-k-k3-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wuxuu weydiiyaa xaqiiqada kale ee maqan.
